title: Third-party vendor
description: Schema for company-profile/<company_id>/vendors/<vendor_id>.json, the register entry for one ICT third-party service provider. Fields follow the DORA register of information (ITS 2024/2956) and the RBI IT outsourcing Master Direction 2023 so the file can be exported to either regulator's template

services.description: EC2, EKS and RDS hosting for the trading platform in ap-south-1 with DR in ap-south-2

evidence.description: SOC 2 Type II report downloaded via AWS Artifact

assurance.scope: Business continuity management system for AWS global infrastructure

companyId.description: Slug of the company that engages the vendor; must equal the company-profile/<company_id> folder name when present

vendorId.description: Slug identifying the vendor; must equal the file name without .json

legalName.description: Registered legal name of the contracting entity

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier of the contracting entity, required by the DORA register where one exists

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of incorporation of the contracting entity

intraGroup.description: True when the provider is a group entity of the company (RBI outsourcing MD group-entity rules; DORA RoI B_05.01 ICT intra-group service provider); feeds concentration-risk reporting in refresh-vendor-ctx

ultimateParent.description: Ultimate parent undertaking of the contracting entity, required by the DORA RoI (B_05.01) where the provider belongs to a group

legalName.description: Registered legal name of the ultimate parent

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier of the ultimate parent where one exists

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of incorporation of the ultimate parent

services.description: ICT services received from this vendor, one entry per distinct service

materiality.description: Materiality per the RBI IT outsourcing Master Direction 2023; material outsourcing needs board approval and regulator notification, and active or exiting material vendors must have contract and lastAssessment on file

substitutability.description: How easily the provider could be replaced, per DORA RoI B_07.01; expected for every material or critical arrangement

assurance.description: Independent assurance reports and certifications held on file for the vendor

lastAssessment.description: Most recent internal third-party risk assessment

rating.description: Residual risk rating assigned by the assessment, on the canonical severity scale without info

assessor.description: Person or team that performed the assessment

findingIds.description: Ledger findings raised against the vendor by this assessment

regulatoryRefs.description: Outsourcing and third-party-risk clauses this vendor relationship is governed by

status.description: Lifecycle state of the vendor relationship

tags.description: Free-form lowercase labels for filtering vendors

serviceId.description: Slug identifying the service within this vendor file

type.description: ICT service type, modelled on the DORA register of information type-of-ICT-services list

description.description: What the service does for the company and which systems it touches

criticality.description: Criticality of the service to the company: critical services support a critical function (supportsCriticalFunction must be true), important ones would cause significant disruption, standard ones are replaceable

supportsCriticalFunction.description: True when the service supports a critical or important function listed in details.json; criticalFunctionRefs is then required and must otherwise be empty or absent

criticalFunctionRefs.description: functionId values from details.json criticalFunctions that this service supports

dataAccessed.description: Highest data classifications the vendor can store or process for this service; empty when the vendor sees no company data

hostingCountries.description: Countries where the service stores or processes company data; compare with details.json dataResidency

subcontractors.description: Fourth parties the vendor relies on to deliver this service, per DORA RoI subcontracting chain

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the subcontractor

role.description: What the subcontractor provides, for example colocation, support desk, DNS

contract.description: Key contractual terms the regulators expect an outsourcing agreement to contain

type.description: Contract structure per DORA RoI B_02.01: standalone agreement, overarching master agreement, or subsequent agreement under an overarching one

reference.description: Contract number or document reference in the contract repository

endDate.description: Contract end date; omit for evergreen contracts

noticePeriodDays.description: Days of notice either party must give to terminate

exitPlanDocumented.description: True when a tested exit or transition plan exists for this vendor

governingLaw.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose law governs the contract

rightToAudit.description: True when the contract grants the company and its regulators audit and inspection rights

subcontractingAllowed.description: True when the vendor may subcontract; RBI expects prior consent for material services

dataReturnAndDeletion.description: True when the contract obliges return and certified deletion of company data on exit

annualValue.description: Approximate annual contract value, used for concentration-risk reporting

type.description: Kind of assurance report or certification; iso22301 and soc1-type2 cover the business-continuity and financial-controls evidence RBI expects for material outsourcing

issuer.description: Auditor or certification body that issued the report

periodStart.description: Start of the period the report covers

periodEnd.description: End of the period the report covers, or the certification date

expiresAt.description: Date after which the report is stale and must be refreshed

scope.description: Services, locations or systems covered by the report

exceptionsCount.description: Number of exceptions or non-conformities noted in the report

evidence.description: Where the report itself is stored
